card.name: Spots just before a size or route word
card.fires_on: Marked spot where the next piece is a number, container size or an 'intra-' or 'upright' style word start. It is often a space or a word start just before a quantity or route.

modes.label: Space before a range or size
modes.description: A blank or space right before a number or size such as a weight band or container size.
modes.example: is 62 mg three times a day ><< >>30 kg to 55 kg

modes.label: Start of route or long word
modes.description: The first piece of a word like intravesical, intranasal, upright or trastuzumab.
modes.example: Administer ADSTILADRIN by<< intr>>avesical instillation only.

modes.label: Before a bracket or count
modes.description: A spot before an opening bracket or a quantity in a recipe or text.

card.writes: It promotes code-like tokens starting with an open bracket, so it adds little clear meaning for text.
card.plain: It fires at the point just before a size, number or route word begins, such as before 'intranasal' or a weight range.
